popia.title: Imfihlo Yakho, Amalungelo Akho
popia.intro: IVulindlela izibophelele ekukhuseleni ulwazi lwakho. Silandela uMthetho woKhuseleko loLwazi loMntu (POPIA).

who_we_are.title: 1. Singobani
who_we_are.content: IVulindlela liQumhu elineXanduva. iGosa lethu loLwazi lingafumaneka ku-privacy@vulindlela.org.za.

what_we_collect.title: 2. Into esiyiqokelelayo
what_we_collect.content: Siqokelela kuphela oko sikudingayo: igama lakho, inombolo yemfonomfono, ilokishi/idolophu, izakhono, nolwimi olukhethayo. Asikubuzi ngenombolo ye-ID okanye iinkcukacha zebhanki.

why_we_collect.title: 3. Kutheni siyiqokelela
why_we_collect.content: Ukukudibanisa namathuba, ukuqinisekisa abaqeshi, nokukugcina ukhuselekile kubuqhophololo (scams).

who_sees_it.title: 4. Ngubani obona ulwazi lwakho
who_sees_it.content: Abaqeshi babona kuphela oko ukhetha ukwabelana nabo. Asinakuze sithengise ulwazi lwakho.

protection.title: 5. Silukhusela njani
protection.content: Ulwazi lwakho lufihliwe (encrypted) kwaye lugcinwe ngokukhuselekileyo.

rights.title: 6. Amalungelo Akho
rights.content: Ungalubona, ulutshintshe, okanye ulucime ulwazi lwakho nangaliphi na ixesha. Ungakwazi nokukhalaza kwi-Information Regulator.

under_18.title: 7. Ukuba ungaphantsi kweminyaka eli-18
under_18.content: Abasebenzisi abaneminyaka eli-15–17 badinga imvume yomzali okanye umgcini nge-OTP.

camera.title: 8. Ikhamera noSetyenziso lweZandla
camera.content: Ukuba usebenzisa izandla (gestures), ividiyo icutshungulwa kwisixhobo sakho kuphela kwaye ayinakuze igcinwe.

popia.consent_processing: Ndiyavuma ukuba iVulindlela isebenzise ulwazi lwam ukuze isebenze i-akhawunti yam. (Kuyanyanzeleka)
popia.consent_employer: Ndiyavuma ukwabelana ngeprofayili yam nabaqeshi abaqinisekisiweyo. (Ngokuzithandela)

shield.title: Ikhaka le-Vulindlela
shield.detector_desc: Ncamathisela uluhlu lwemisebenzi okanye umyalezo ngezantsi ukuze uhlole iimpawu eziyingozi.

accessibility.title: Ukufikeleleka
accessibility.question: Ngaba ufuna ukuba le app isebenze ngendlela eyahlukileyo kuwe?
